kind.description: Artefact kind (role_words, direction_declarations, ...). The loader consumes kind role_words; other kinds are consumed as data through the payload's own declarations.

note.description: What the artefact is and how it is consumed. Informational.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the artefact file.

sha256.description: The pin over the artefact's bytes.

status.description: in_force: live pack data. in_force_emission_data_only: in force as emission data only (read by the batch path as data; not a prompt surface).

artefacts.description: The candidate's pinned files, when it is an artefact set rather than a single file.

conformance.description: Pointer to the conformance entry that prices this candidate (a conformance record entry id, e.g. CR-3).

id.description: Candidate identifier within the pack (T1, T2a, ...), when the candidate is one of a named series.

kind.description: Candidate kind: setup_config (a pinned payload file) or a content variant kind (guidance_variant, fitted_artefact, ...).

note.description: What the candidate is and the standing of its measurement.

path.description: Repo-relative path, when the candidate is a single pinned file (the setup_config candidate shape).

profile_version.description: The candidate payload's profile-lineage version (single-file shape).

sha256.description: The pin over the candidate file's bytes (single-file shape).

status.description: candidate_not_in_force: pinned, not yet priced by a registered gate. measured_not_adopted: priced and not adopted. closed: priced and the route itself closed against re-proposal without new evidence.

path.description: Path of one of the candidate's files, as recorded when the candidate was measured.

sha256.description: The pin over that file's bytes.

id.description: Note identifier within the pack (CN-1, CN-2, ...).

status.description: in_force: the note states a rule the in-force payload/resolution follows. observed_not_in_force: an observation recorded for future fitting; it governs nothing.

kind.description: Payload kind. Format 1 carries exactly one setup_config payload.

note.description: What this payload is and why these are its bytes. Informational.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the payload file (packs/<pack_id>/profile/setup_config.json).

profile_version.description: The payload's own profile-lineage version, recorded in per-run pack provenance.

sha256.description: The pin: the loader refuses a payload whose bytes hash differently.
Lowercase hex sha256 of the pinned file's bytes.

description: The field-level schema for a pack manifest, formalizing docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §1. The loader (pipeline.profile_config.load_pack_manifest) validates every manifest against this schema and refuses on any defect, naming it. Unknown fields are refused (additionalProperties: false): a field the schema does not define is a format change, never a silent extra. Validated by pipeline.pack_schema, which implements the subset of JSON Schema draft 2020-12 used here.

artefacts.description: In-force pack data files beyond the payload, each pinned by path + sha256 (e.g. the role_words vocabulary the loader consumes).

assembled.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) this manifest version was assembled.

candidates.description: Pinned content that is NOT in force at this version: measured (or awaiting measurement) under PACK_DESIGN §2, adoptable only as a new pack version after a passing registered gate.

conformance_record.description: Pack-relative filename of the conformance record (conformance.json). The record follows packs/conformance.schema.json.

contents_index.description: Human-auditable map of what the payload carries: topic -> one-paragraph description. Descriptive only; the payload is normative (PACK_DESIGN §1.1 rule a).

convention_notes.description: Corpus-convention observations fitted from fitting-side data only, in aggregate form (PACK_DESIGN §2.3).

design.description: Design source for the pack's content. Shipped packs cite only documents in this tree (docs/PACK_DESIGN.md).

display_name.description: Human-facing pack name (Legal Contract). Informational; identity is pack_id.

emitted_by.description: Emitter identity for builder-emitted packs (the ontology builder's version stamp). Absent on hand-assembled packs.

pack_format.description: Manifest format version. Format 1 carries exactly one setup_config payload.

pack_id.description: The domain's stable slug (legal-contract). Never changes across versions; the pack directory carries this name.

pack_version.description: Semantic version of the pack's in-force content. Any change to the payload or the manifest's in-force declarations is a bump, never an in-place edit (PACK_DESIGN §1.2).

payload.description: The one setup_config payload this pack binds, pinned by sha256.

profile_family.description: The profile lineage this pack binds. Pack lookup matches on this field, never on directory names.

scope.description: What corpus/domain scope the pack's record covers, when a one-line statement exists (the core pack carries one). Informational.

status.description: Lifecycle of this pack version: in_force (the version a resolution loads), superseded (kept for the record, no longer the in-force version), draft (assembled, not yet in force).

validated_on.description: The dataset the pack's in-force content was validated on, when it is a single named dataset (Re-DocRED, BioRED, CUAD). Informational; the conformance record is normative.
